text: What's new in N G prism twenty-two point seven.
A new look, built on one brand palette, in dark and in light.
It's fully responsive now. On a phone, the navigation opens full screen, and every control fits a finger.
Services and pipes get their own pages, generated from their code and their J S Doc.
Showcases can hold real templates now, compiled by Angular, with components and directives working together.
A component that only lives inside another becomes a part, shown on its parent's page.
Accessibility violations you accept stay visible, with their reason, but no longer count against the score.
And bundle size measures the code you actually ship.
